name: survarium::atmosphere::update_parameters

name: survarium::third_person_camera_controller::place_camera

name: survarium::third_person_camera_controller::tick

name: survarium::third_person_camera_controller::orbit_transform

name: survarium::third_person_view_camera_controller::pivot

name: survarium::third_person_preview_camera_controller::tick
evidence: Descriptive name: slot 1 of vtable 0x200981198 (RTTI; the kill camera's preview, set by spectator_camera_controller at 0x2001e3fe5); distance = min of collide_distance at its angles (+118h, +11Ch) turned by 0.1 and 0.5 rad and at them (distance +120h); below 0.75 the last angles with room (+124h, +128h) are placed instead, else they are stored; then place_camera.
